answer: Each identity stakes 190 POA to grow one lotus in the shared pond, threading a single pearl onto its stem as the mark of their first job receipt; when the gale rises at dawn, two neighbors watch whether the pearl holds fast, and a forged lotus sheds its pearl, the 190 POA kept and the owner barred five epochs; ten clones need ten lotuses, ten pearls and ten separate plantings, 1,900 POA in all, with no lotus, pearl or planting shared or reused.
